text:
alex: Quick async standup — SRE check-in.
What I did: fixed noisy alert (alert-id: slo-req-5xx), ran daily rollup for /embed-prod SLOs, added a 2h suppression for the noisy window.
Blockers: still seeing ~50% variance on p95 in us-west during traffic spikes; hard to repro locally.
Today: tune batching policy, follow up with infra for a test node, and update the runbook with heap dump steps. :clipboard:

maria: Nice. Can you paste the suppression rule you deployed? I need to mirror it for Dedicated infra.

alex: pasted below
```
alert: slo-req-5xx
squelch: 2h
scope: service:api-embed
threshold: 0.015
```
Also set `escalation: false` for the suppression window — manual PD pages only.

jamal: Oncall note — got a PD page at 03:12 UTC for p95 spike. Root cause looked like a long GC pause on worker-3. I restarted the process and GC log tail looks back to normal. Filing follow-up.

tess: Thanks. Jamal, can you attach the GC log snippet to the incident ticket? ticket #SRE-472 please.

jamal: added logs + timeline to SRE-472. Also left a note to add heap dump collection to the oncall playbook (step + command).

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: 2024-04-30 08:45 UTC — service=embed-worker version=v2.3.1

oliver: FYI — I rolled a canary for batch-config change (batch size 10 -> 20). Observability: slight drop in per-token CPU, p50 latency improved, p95 unchanged so far. Will continue ramp if p95 stabilizes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: blocker: trying to repro 50% variance locally but env mismatch (memory/cpu). Asking infra for a test node with similar specs to worker-3. @oliver can you share the run args?

alex: noted. @oliver can you share the exact docker args? I'll also add a heatmap of latency by request size to the SLO dashboard to help triage.

oliver: docker args: `--memory=48g --cpus=12 --env INFERENCE_BATCH=20 --gpus=1`.
I'll push the docker-compose snippet to the eng-sre channel in a bit.

tess: Outstanding items for today:
1) run batching A/B for 1 hour (owner: oliver)
2) update runbook with heap dump step (owner: jamal)
3) sanity-check dedupe rules on alerting (owner: tess)
I'll own #3. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Oncall follow-ups: opening PR to infra-config to bump logs retention to 30d for embed-service (we keep needing older traces). Also adding heap dump command to the playbook.

alex: pinging infra team — @matthew-infra can we get a temp test node similar to worker-3 specs? will help repro p95 variance.

matthew-infra: provisioning now. ETA ~45m. Will DM access when ready.

tess: if provisioning takes too long, we can run a synthetic load in staging with an adjusted seed to force long-tail behavior.

jamal: FYI — I'll add alert suppression to PD for the scheduled canary window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC and update the calendar entry.

oliver: I'll keep monitoring dashboards and post a short summary in ~2h after the canary ramp.

alex: thanks all. If anyone hits the p95 again, drop a note in this thread and tag paging. :thumbsup:
